subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word

It is a __betterment__ of his work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"betterment"** means improvement or progress in something; it signifies enhancement or a positive change. (सुधार)

 
 
• **Example:** The new policies aim at the betterment of living conditions for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **"Worsening"** refers to a decline or deterioration in the condition, quality, or situation of something; it is the opposite of betterment. (बिगड़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** The worsening weather forced us to cancel the outdoor event.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'betterment'** is **'worsening'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Popularity** (लोकप्रियता): The state of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

 
 
• **Example:** Her popularity grew after her recent achievements in sports.
 
 
 
• **Growth** (वृद्धि): Increase in size, number, or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** The growth of the company has been phenomenal this year.
 
 
 
• **Improvement** (सुधार): The process of making something better or enhancing its quality.
 
 
• **Example:** There has been a noticeable improvement in her performance at work.
